title: Bolt.new shoots us into the future of prompt to deployed app with Eric Simons
description:
StackBlitz has always brought the future of development forward, and with recently launched Bolt.new, you can quickly build, run, edit, and deploy rich full-stack web applications from a simple prompt. Let's see how this all works, and where things are going from here.

Eric Simons, Founder / CEO of StackBlitz
Eric has spent most decades of his life using & building things for the web. As the co-founder and CEO of StackBlitz, he's currently bringing dev environments to the browser enabling everyone in the world to build the web, on the web. Previously he created the online course platforms Thinkster.io and RealWorld.io for teaching modern web development.
